title: Strain reference profile
description: The typical terpene profile of a named strain, used as a fallback when a shelf listing carries no lab data. This is an expectation, never a measurement: a reference entry describes what a strain usually tastes like, not what is in any particular jar. Two growers, two harvests and six months on a shelf all move the real numbers.

aliases.description: Spellings seen on real menus: 'Gelato #33', 'Gelato 33', 'Larry Bird'. This is what makes matching a raw menu name work.

profile.description: Median terpene profile. Ordered by percent descending.

observations.description: How many lab results this median rests on. One observation is an anecdote; the UI should treat a thin entry accordingly.

kind.description: AGGREGATED_COA: computed from certificates this project collected — the preferred basis, because we can show our working and it carries no licence question. EXTERNAL_DATASET: imported from a third-party source, which must be named and licence-checked before use.

datasetLicence.description: The licence permitting this use. An external entry without one must not ship.

confidence.description: HIGH needs a double-digit sample count from independent labs. A single COA is LOW no matter how precise its numbers look.
